title: Identification of mitophagy-related genes with potential clinical utility in myocardial infarction at transcriptional level
summary: Feature selection on two GEO datasets identified ATG5, TOMM20 and MFN2 as genes that differed transcriptionally between myocardial-infarction and stable-coronary-disease samples. Logistic-regression AUCs were 0.914 internally and 0.930 in an external GEO dataset; this is retrospective expression-based classification, not prospective diagnosis.
ai_technology: SVM/RF/LASSO feature selection and logistic regression identify a three-gene myocardial-infarction signature.
organization: Department of Cardiology, Beijing Hospital, National Center of Gerontology; Institute of Geriatric Medicine, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences, Beijing, China

evidence.tested: ATG5, TOMM20 and MFN2 expression distinguishes MI from stable coronary disease in the analyzed datasets.
evidence.unknown: The check used existing GEO expression datasets; clinical prospective performance was not tested.
evidence.ai_role: SVM/RF/LASSO feature selection and logistic regression identify a three-gene myocardial-infarction signature.
